prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting interfaces `MemberRecord`, `MemberQuery`, `MemberPage`, and function `queryMembers(records: readonly MemberRecord[], query: MemberQuery): MemberPage`. Each record has `id`, `contact`, and `tier` strings. Query has `contactText`, `page`, and `pageSize`. Trim the search text and perform a case-insensitive substring match against contact. Preserve input order among matches. Page numbering is one-based; page and pageSize must be positive safe integers or throw `RangeError`. Non-array records, malformed records, or non-string search text must throw `TypeError`. A page past the end returns no items. `totalPages` is zero when there are no matches, otherwise the ceiling of total/pageSize. Return cloned record objects so mutating the result cannot affect the input, and never mutate the supplied array or query.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
